name: By What Authority?
desc: Benson's first Catholic novel (1904), set in Elizabethan England: Isabel Norris and her family, Anglican gentry, are drawn through the persecution of Catholics to ask on what authority the Church of England stands, and to the Mass.
desc_pt: O primeiro romance católico de Benson (1904), na Inglaterra isabelina: Isabel Norris e sua família, fidalguia anglicana, são levadas, através da perseguição aos católicos, a perguntar em que autoridade se funda a Igreja da Inglaterra, e até à Missa.
edition: By What Authority? (London: Isbister, 1904), Project Gutenberg #19697, proofread.
srcnote: Parts and chapters as printed; the numbered sections inside chapters are kept as ## headings.
